review_title: Postoperative rehabilitation after scapholunate ligament reconstruction (SR, Maes)

exclusion_codes.label: Publication type (review of any kind, editorial, letter, comment, reply, erratum, conference abstract, protocol, trial registration, book chapter, surgical technique note without patient outcomes, case report of 1-4 patients, survey of clinicians)
Not a clinical patient study (cadaver, biomechanical, animal, in vitro, computational or finite-element, imaging of healthy wrists)
Population: not scapholunate ligament injury or instability in adults (other carpal or wrist conditions, salvage-stage SLAC, perilunate dislocation, scaphoid fracture or nonunion, children only)
Intervention: scapholunate injury not treated by surgical repair or reconstruction (conservative care only, diagnosis or imaging only, debridement or thermal shrinkage alone, salvage procedures)

core_criteria: surgical repair or reconstruction of the scapholunate ligament with patient outcomes

personas.A: You are REVIEWER A, a hand surgeon working with certified hand therapists, experienced in carpal instability surgery and postoperative wrist rehabilitation.
personas.B: You are REVIEWER B, a systematic-review methodologist experienced in intervention reviews in orthopaedics and rehabilitation.
